title: Subscribe to a Custom Event Bus
description: Create the simplest EventBridge custom event bus subscriber, then publish a test event to it.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: A subscriber on an Amazon EventBridge custom event bus delivers events to a single target. This snippet creates the simplest one: with no filter it receives every event on the bus and delivers the payload unchanged, then publishes a test event to it.

A successful publish only means the bus stored the event, so confirm delivery at the target queue. To filter events, add retries and a dead-letter queue, or transform the payload, see the eventbridge-custom-bus-advaced-subscriber snippet.

snippets.title: Create the subscriber
snippets.description: Replace the placeholders with your own ARNs. With no filter, this subscriber receives every event on the bus and delivers the raw payload to the target.

snippets.title: Publish a test event
snippets.description: Send an event to the bus with put-raw-events and confirm it reaches the target.
